# Asset provenance

The seven shopper images were supplied by the AmogOS project and are retained
unchanged under assets/characters/.

Application icons and the VLC featured screenshot came from the corresponding
Flathub AppStream records at https://flathub.org/api/v2/appstream/:

- org.videolan.VLC
- com.valvesoftware.Steam
- com.heroicgameslauncher.hgl
- com.discordapp.Discord
- com.thebrokenrail.MCPIReborn
- org.gimp.GIMP
- org.mozilla.firefox
- org.kde.krita
- org.libreoffice.LibreOffice

The preview catalog is a dated snapshot for the labelled Windows design preview.
Real Linux installations query the configured APT repositories, Flathub, and
AppImageHub. Bundled icons remain the property of their respective projects.
Manrope's OFL and the Flutter template license are retained in this directory.
